title: Payment webhooks
brief: Receive the payment provider's webhooks. Each is signed: X-Signature is the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body under our shared secret. Apply a webhook only if its signature is valid; reject an unsigned or mis-signed one with 401.
tasks: Add webhook.Handler verifying X-Signature before applying
Test a signed webhook and a mis-signed one

expected.why: A signature mismatch is only logged; the handler falls through and applies the body, so anyone can post a forged payment event.
The shared signing secret is written to the log on every request, so anyone who can read logs can forge webhooks.
The task names a mis-signed webhook test; only the signed path is tested, which is why D1 passes.
